_comment: Basis record for every threshold, band, coefficient and default the analysis uses (PHASE2_SPEC §3.1). basis_type: standard | regulatory | literature | statistical | project_choice | provisional. A provisional value, or a project_choice without approved_by, is labelled PROVISIONAL and its severity is capped at moderate. References are ids in PHASE2_SPEC §12.
